description: Bitfinex spot ticker for one or more pairs (e.g. tBTCUSD,tETHUSD): bid, ask, last, 24h change and volume, from Bitfinex's public v2 ticker endpoint. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bitget_tickers when you need Bitget spot ticker for one pair: last price, bid/ask, 24h; finance_bitstamp_tickers when you need Bitstamp spot ticker for one pair: last, bid, ask, 24h. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

symbols.description: Comma-separated Bitfinex v2 symbols with t prefix, up to 10 (e.g. tBTCUSD,tETHUSD)

name: finance_bitfinex_tickers
title: Bitfinex spot ticker for one or more pairs: bid, ask, last
